utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Pia — send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll keep an eye on the tally so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — I’ll send the list and drop-off details soon. I’m just trying to keep the logistics simple so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, Pia — I’ll watch for it and check the numbers on my end. Thanks for keeping it simple.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’ve got the update now. I can help if I can track down duct tape, a Phillips screwdriver, or a few spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — if you can grab any of those, drop them by my place and I’ll sort the rest. I’ll keep you posted if anything else turns up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll look for those and bring them by if I find them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Dane — that should cover the repair drive set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Glad to help—I’ll swing by with the paint, gloves, and a couple work lights.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Dane — that should get us set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’ll wait for the location. Just let me know when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the location now — I’ll send it over as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, it’s happening. Send me the details and I’ll help sort the sign-up list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Leo — I’ll send the details and the latest sign-up list over soon. Thanks for helping keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send it over when you can, and I’ll sort through the list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can check the drill battery tonight and let you know what supplies are still needed before you decide on the tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — what time is the repair drive, and what supplies still need to be brought?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m not sure of the exact time yet, but I’ll check tonight and get back to you with what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Noah — I can spread the word and keep an eye on donations. Just send me the details once Opal confirms the location.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — I’m still waiting on Opal to confirm the location, and I’ll send the details your way as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I’ll keep an eye on donations and share the word once you send the location.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — I’ll be there Saturday at 9 and help sort everything out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Sam — 9 works great, and I really appreciate you helping sort everything out. I’ll let folks know you’re coming by then.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Tess — I’m looking forward to it and I’ll be there Saturday at 9 ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s really happening, right? Send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it’s happening. I’ll send the details as soon as I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, I’ll wait for your details then—just confirming it’s still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do, Kira—I’ll keep you posted on who reaches out and what they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it’s definitely on then? I just wanted to confirm before I tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, it’s definitely on—I’ll keep spreading the word and let you know who’s coming with hands, tools, or spare supplies.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course, Uli — I’ll keep it quiet and listen for anything useful about the repair drive. If I hear more, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I really appreciate you keeping it quiet — I can still help Saturday morning if that’s alright.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That still works, Uli — Saturday morning is fine, and I’ll keep it between us. If I hear anything new about the repair drive, I’ll pass it along quietly.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye—I'll keep an eye out for it and plan to be ready right around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli — I’ll send the schedule soon and keep it lined up with pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye—I’ll watch for the schedule and be ready right around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely—I’ll keep spreading the word while I’m out: we still need a few more volunteers, plus hands, tools, and spare supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira—I’ll keep linking folks up and let you know who’s ready to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I’ll keep an eye out and let folks know you’re still looking for a few more volunteers and supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m checking the latest location now, and I’ll let you know where the repair drive is set up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Opal—Maple Street is still the first stop, and I’ll send the next locations as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — Maple Street is first, and I’ll keep an eye out for the next stops.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can lend a hand for a couple hours on Saturday morning, and I’ve got a drill and a small wrench set you can use.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli — what time on Saturday morning works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Around 9 should be fine for me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — I’ll check and send over what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Bo — that should get us set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No problem — I’ll take a quick look and let you know if anything else is missing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning still looks good on my end—I’ll double-check the school schedule and make sure it doesn’t conflict.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Faye—thanks for checking. I’ll bring the drill and screwdrivers Saturday morning unless you hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll confirm the school schedule and let you know if anything changes. Saturday morning should work otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa — I can help with the nearest roof leak or broken window. Just tell me what tools to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Rey — the nearest roof leak is the top priority, and a basic ladder, tarp, and hammer would help most. I’ll point you to the exact spot at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll bring a ladder, tarp, and hammer to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll head over early and see what needs fixing first. If there’s a list already, I’ll follow it and let you know what they need most.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll wait to hear what they say needs the most help first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll check in early and pass along the top priorities once I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll use the updated plan for Sunday at the community center and start organizing the repair list now. Let’s match the biggest needs with volunteers first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll help match each repair to the right volunteers so we can keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam — I’ll keep the list updated and flag the most urgent repairs first. Once we’ve matched those, we can confirm the rest of the volunteer assignments.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — send me the latest tally as soon as you have Pia’s list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll check Pia’s list and send you the latest tally as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren — I’ll wait for the latest tally.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll send the repair drive details as soon as I’ve got them, and I’m glad you’re coming by to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — just send them when you can, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the details soon, and thanks again for helping out!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still happy to help, but can we confirm the timing and the who-brings-what list first?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check the timing and the who-brings-what list, then send it over. I’m still planning to bring my tools and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. Once you send it over, I can see what I can cover too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll head to the porch donations now and help load the last boxes after.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Dane — start with the porch donations, then bring the sorted boxes to the garage when you’re done.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: On it — I’ll sort the porch donations first, then bring the boxes over to the garage.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — please let me know the time once you’ve checked, and I can help with sorting volunteers and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check the time on my next errand and get back to you with the supplies that are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll wait for the time update and then help sort the volunteers and supplies.
